title: Vehicle disposal fund uses and $25 fee
summary: On September 1, the committee reviewed the Vehicle Disposal Fee Fund but took no legislative action; the chair said the committee will work with the department and return with a bill. The fund holds over $19 million, with about $3 million budgeted for fiscal year 27, and drivers pay a $25 registration fee into it. The department wants to keep the fee at $25 because substantial CIP costs are coming, and said County code could be amended to widen how the money is used.
